decisions.reason: The accelerator fits the firm's advisory capabilities and partnership-led growth strategy, and its continued homepage prominence through 2024 suggests it remains strategically useful for deal flow and ecosystem building.

A CO2-negative binder supports the firm's circular-value proposition by turning waste streams into higher-value materials, and its dedicated product page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates ongoing commercial commitment.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant is close to the core business of modular waste-treatment equipment and was still actively highlighted on the homepage in 2024, so it should remain in the portfolio.

Although strategically close to the core offer, the mobile mechanical recycling plant disappeared from the website in 2024, which points to weak traction or reprioritization versus stronger recycling and decontamination lines.
